finding_results.reason: Active package/tracker resolution is package-neutral and fail-closed; historical audit baseline is explicitly non-live.
Designated live projections agree with PKG-03 10/25 cursor 03.11 and are guarded by Repository Governance.

Non-authoritative WIP/checkpoint and next-safe-action semantics exist, but the approved checkpoint contract requires first-class last_verified_action, blockers, and gates records; those are not durably represented as explicit schema fields.

Bidirectional adoption audit exists, but approved state IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED is represented as IMPLEMENTED_BUT_NOT_VERIFIED. Approved vocabulary is part of the amendment contract and must be exact.
All six approved project states and evidence-backed AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN capability states are represented.
Canonical acceptance and non-authoritative WIP are explicitly separate; WIP cannot promote tracker completion.
Historical blueprint is labeled HISTORICAL BASELINE — NOT LIVE EXECUTION STATE and points to live authorities.

Implementation-gap states exist, but the approved change classification CORRECTION/COMPLETION/HARDENING/OPTIMIZATION/NEW_PRODUCT_SCOPE is absent; NEW_PRODUCT_SCOPE explicit-approval/no-auto-implementation semantics are therefore not machine-readable.

Approval references/inheritance/reapproval triggers exist, but approved scope vocabulary TASK/MODULE/MILESTONE/PHASE/PROJECT is not represented exactly; current scope enum substitutes WORK_PACKAGE/FEATURE/RELEASE/PRIVILEGED_ACTION.

Module IDs/options/applicability exist, but the approved deep module contract does not yet require identity, interfaces, permissions, data, workflows, integrations, security, UI states, responsive/accessibility, testing, rollback and acceptance with non-applicable rationale.
must_not, abuse_cases and forbidden_boundaries are first-class contract fields and negative requirements are acceptance obligations.
Expected changes, shared surfaces, scope budgets and STOP_AND_REASSESS behavior are explicit.

Collision handling exists, but approved classes PARALLEL_SAFE/COORDINATED_PARALLEL/SERIALIZE/BLOCKED are not represented exactly; current enum uses SERIALIZE_SHARED_SURFACE/EXCLUSIVE and lacks package-concurrency-authority metadata.
FAST GATE and FULL GATE are distinct, and fast evidence cannot substitute for final/full acceptance.
BASELINE_FAILURE requires canonical-base reproduction; retry-until-green is prohibited and flaky tests require defect/quarantine evidence.

COMPLETE/PARTIALLY_COMPLETE semantics exist, but universal DoD criteria do not explicitly cover all approved security, data integrity, error handling, integration, known limitations, VCS/checkpoint and rollback/recovery obligations.

Review provenance exists, but approved labels SELF_REVIEW/INDEPENDENT_AI_REVIEW/HUMAN_REVIEW/REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_REVIEW are not exact; REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_REVIEW is absent and automated evidence is mixed into review provenance.
Structured/audit logging, request IDs, health, metrics, alerts, job monitoring, troubleshooting/runbook and sensitive-log policy have required-or-rationale semantics.
BUILT/DEPLOYED/RELEASED/PRODUCTION_VERIFIED and all four recovery classes are distinct and evidence-bound; IRREVERSIBLE requires exact explicit approval.
Incident sequence matches Stabilize -> Contain -> Preserve Evidence -> Diagnose -> Recover -> Verify -> Root Cause -> Prevent Recurrence and blocks broad feature refactoring during containment.
Approved stop-the-line triggers plus repository/evidence-integrity extensions are explicit, and stopped surfaces block normal feature mutation.
Durable report includes changed/why/research/checks/security/data/affected/VCS/docs/issues/not-verified/next-action and unrelated findings require separate queue/change control.

next_safe_action: Remediate findings 3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 13, 16 and 17 within the already-approved governance scope; run exact-head governance gates; merge; then run a second read-only 22-item audit from refreshed canonical main.
